description: This PHP source file provides utility functions related to security and access control within the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions for query module access, user roles, allowed/disallowed modules, client IP detection, and array value assignment.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Controller for handling tab access related functionalities.

classes.name: Roles
classes.description: Model class representing user role data and permissions.

methods.name: query_module_access_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of modules accessible by the specified user.

methods.name: query_user_has_roles
methods.description: Checks whether the user has any roles assigned.

methods.name: get_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules the user is allowed to access.

methods.name: get_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Returns modules the user is explicitly disallowed from accessing.

methods.name: query_client_ip
methods.description: Determines and returns the client's IP address by inspecting server variables.

methods.name: get_val_array
methods.description: Creates an associative array where keys and values are identical, based on the input array's keys.
